newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Kwoon Chung seen in HK$106 mln IPO - sources.
newsitem.headline: HK's Kwoon Chung seen in HK$106 mln IPO - sources.

text.p: Hong Kong-based bus line operator Kwoon Chung Bus Holdings Ltd is expected to raise about HK$106 million by issuing 59 million new shares, or 25 percent of its expanded share capital, at HK$1.80 per share, market sources said on Wednesday.
The offering is expected to take place from September 13-18 with dealing in shares beginning on September 25, sources said.
HSBC Investment Bank Asia Ltd is the sponsor of the issue.
Kwoon Chung provides non-franchised bus services on Hong Kong Island and franchised buses on Lantau Island. It is scheduled to hold a press briefing on the flotation on Thursday.
Sources said proceeds would be used to fund non-franchised bus ventures and operations in major cities in China.

The company forecast a net profit of not less than HK$53 million for the year ending March 31, 1997. It posted a net profit of HK$41 million for 1996, HK$40.8 million for 1995 and HK$33.8 million for 1994, sources added.
